key_insight: ISDS-MRI combines graph neural networks and sequence-specific modeling to detect ischemic stroke, segment lesions, and estimate lesion volume even when some MRI sequences are missing.
clinical_relevance: This could support faster, more consistent stroke MRI interpretation in settings with limited specialists or incomplete imaging protocols.
method: Unified AI framework for detection, segmentation, and volume estimation
Uses multi-sequence MRI with handling for missing sequences
Evaluated across multiple public datasets plus a new 532-scan multi-center Bangladesh cohort
evidence_signal: In the abstract, ISDS-MRI achieved Dice 0.725 for lesion segmentation, AUC 0.962 for detection, and 8.4% relative error for volume estimation, outperforming comparison methods.
watch_item: Performance was reported across curated datasets, but real-world deployment still depends on external validation, workflow integration, and consistent MRI quality across sites.
paper_title: Ischemic Stroke Detection, Segmentation, and Volume Estimation using Multi-sequence MRI Data with Missing Sequences
